mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tOrdOrderProdApprovLine ( OrderNo, OrderProdNo, ApprovLevel, ApprovCustId, ApprovCustName, State, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate ) SELECT #{orderNo}, #{orderProdNo}, AL.ApprovLevel, AL.CustId, AL.CustName, 1, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW() FROM shopion.tPrfCustApprovLine AL WHERE AL.CustId = (SELECT CustId FROM shopion.tOrdOrder WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo})
